title: 2 Hour Historic Market Food Tour and Hands-On Biscuit Class
includes: A hands-on Southern biscuit class + tasting
Alternative Menu Options: Vegetarian, Gluten Free, Dairy Free, Vegan.
This tour is wheelchair accessible but not ADA compliant (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Children must be accompanied by an adult.
policies: Walking is involved, but is limited to the market and immediate surrounding area. Please wear comfortable shoes.
Operates in all weather conditions, rain or shine; please dress appropriately.
Please advise dietary requirements at time of booking.
When available, our evening market tours offer a calm, crowd-free alternative to the daytime rush. Enjoy a quieter experience that may feel like the market is open just for you.
There is a small parking lot attached to the back of the Curb Market. Parking availability and cost is as always subject to change.

Please be sure to contact the Municipal Market directly for the most up to date information on hourly parking rates, as our tour is a solid two hour experience, and additional parking time is often necessary.
There may be metered street parking, and additional lots with available parking in the area. But this parking is not affiliated with the market and therefore rates and availability are unknown.
Arriving via public transportation or rideshare is encouraged.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
You won’t want to miss this Atlanta food experience. In just two hours, you will try delicious tastings from 4 food vendors in Atlanta’s oldest market and become Southern cooks with a hands-on Atlanta cooking class.

You’ll learn fascinating Atlanta history and get a close look at Southern cooking and Georgia’s most famous foods, including peaches, collards, and pecans. And, you will love learning how to make the perfect Southern biscuit.

During December, you'll make fun snowman decorated biscuits!
